race.description: Harvey Norman Ararat Mdn Plate Highweight
race.comment: A very plain maiden to kick things off. PARAMOUNT WAR (6) was retired from the event last start so put a pen through that run. Good effort over 1700m at Warrnambool the run before where he closed in good style to be beaten just half a length. Filled a placing at his only try at this distance. Brings the right form to the table. ALLTOGETHERNOW (2) finished just behind PARAMOUNT WAR when they clashed over 1700m at The Bool three back. Two subsequent runs over today's journey have been poor. Has more to offer - worth one more chance. ROCKIN' DEE FOX (7) was lining up for the second time this prep when an eye-catching second over this distance at Donald recently, defeating some of today's rivals. Has improvement to come and looks a great chance to break the ice. VADAR (8) disappointed at Seymour last start after an encouraging effort at Traralgon two back. Can make amends. CHARLIE MESSY HAIR (4) has been about the money of late and will run this trip right out.
